name: 32114 · Daytona Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 32114 (Daytona Beach) has 199 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32114 (Daytona Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32114 (Daytona Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
